organisation.name: Vault (the service organisation)
organisation.scope: The Vault platform: ingestion, the gate, the fact store, the sealed archive, the ledger, and the control surface.

observationWindow.minimumPeriod: not applicable — ISO certification audits a management system, not a period of operating effectiveness
observationWindow.statement: ISO 27001 and 42001 certification assess whether the management system is designed and operating, in a Stage 1 (documentation) and Stage 2 (implementation) audit. No fixed observation window applies, but Stage 2 expects records showing the system has been operating, typically for at least three months.
